Package dev.px.core.test.harness

Class FakePlatform

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.test.harness.FakePlatform
All Implemented Interfaces:
Platform
public final class FakePlatform extends Object implements Platform
A Platform backed by plain fields.

This class is the proof that Core's game seam is narrow enough to be useful. Everything Core needs from Minecraft is thirteen methods, and all of them can be answered by a temp directory and four floats.

Screen size and cursor are writable so tests can change resolution and drive a drag without a window.
